title: Elux Legend Strawberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Strawberry Ice Nic Salt delivers the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries lifted by a crisp, cooling Ice finish. The fruit notes are vivid and summery, offering a burst of fresh Strawberry flavour, while the chilled exhale adds a brisk, clean edge for a balanced and refreshing vape. Blended with double-concentrated flavouring, this e-liquid reflects the punchy profiles that made Elux disposables so popular—now available in a refillable nic salt format. With a 50VG/50PG ratio and smooth nicotine salt formulation, Strawberry Ice is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. Expect satisfying flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
